brief: 5 myths about AI replacing your job that founders need to stop believing.

slots.title: AI replaces every job overnight
slots.body: Founders panic that algorithms will make their team obsolete by next quarter. The reality is adoption curves are slow and uneven across industries.
slots.takeaway: Automation is a marathon, not a sprint.

slots.title: Only tech roles are AI-safe
slots.body: Many believe soft skills and creative judgment are easily replicated. In truth, empathy and strategic vision remain incredibly hard to automate.
slots.takeaway: Human judgment is the real moat.

slots.title: You must force AI into everything
slots.body: Forcing AI into processes that don't need it wastes time and capital. Smart founders automate the boring stuff, not the brand-building stuff.
slots.takeaway: Deploy AI with intent, not FOMO.

slots.title: AI lets you run tiny teams
slots.body: Some think tools replace headcount one-for-one. Actually, augmented teams often scale faster because output per person skyrockets.
slots.takeaway: AI amplifies people, it doesn't erase them.

slots.title: Ignoring AI kills your startup fast
slots.body: Hype cycles make delay feel fatal. While awareness matters, thoughtful integration beats rushed gimmicks every single time.
slots.takeaway: Speed without strategy is just noise.

slots.title: The real risk is doing nothing
slots.body: AI won't steal your job, but a founder using AI might outpace you. The gap grows between those who experiment and those who wait.
slots.takeaway: Start small, start now, stay human.

slots.body: Drop a comment and tag a founder who needs to see this reality check today.
